# David Plappert

> Fractional AWS Reliability Lead for revenue-critical systems. Twenty years AWS since EC2 beta. US Patent holder (11,146,689). Two-time AWS City on a Cloud Award winner (2016, 2018). Based in Peoria, Illinois — working remote globally.

## About

David Plappert is a senior cloud architect and Fractional AWS Reliability Lead. He provides production reliability services for Fortune 100 and mid-market companies running revenue-critical systems on Amazon Web Services. His career spans 20 years of AWS work since EC2 beta (2006), 10 years as Principal Digital Architect at IdeaCrew architecting healthcare insurance exchange systems processing over $500 million per year in payments, and ongoing work on enterprise vendor-shipped AWS production environments.

- US Patent 11,146,689 (cloud architecture, issued October 12, 2021): https://patents.google.com/patent/US11146689
- Amazon Web Services (AWS) City on a Cloud Award (2016) — Best Practices Award for DC Health Link / IdeaCrew: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/publicsector/city-on-a-cloud-innovation-challenge-best-practices-award-winners/
- Amazon Web Services (AWS) City on a Cloud Award (2018) — IdeaCrew's open-source cloud technology recognized for second time: https://www.prweb.com/releases/ideacrews_open_source_cloud_based_technology_powers_dc_health_link_to_second_prestigious_amazon_award/prweb15631477.htm
- Principal Digital Architect — 10-year title at IdeaCrew
- 20 years of AWS experience since EC2 beta (2006)
- $500M+ per year in production payments architected on AWS serverless
- $1M/month cloud infrastructure budget managed across 12 AWS and 3 Azure accounts
- Led SOC 2 certification and HIPAA-compliant systems for state healthcare exchanges

## What David Does

David solves three core problems for engineering leaders:

1. **Vendor-shipped AWS gatekeeping** — When a vendor delivers AWS infrastructure on a monthly cadence and your team can't independently audit it before production. See full guide: https://davidplappert.com/guides/vendor-shipped-aws-gatekeeping
2. **Production reliability ownership** — Senior AWS architecture, observability design, and 24x7 escalation coverage for revenue-bearing systems.
3. **Cloud cost reality check** — Finding the AWS waste that engineering teams don't have time to audit and writing the remediation roadmap.

## Services

- **Fractional AWS Reliability Lead** — ongoing retainer; embedded senior IC ownership of production AWS, vendor-release gatekeeping, observability design, and 24x7 escalation. Typical commitment: ten to twenty hours per week.
- **AWS Production Audit** — fixed-scope project; comprehensive production reliability and cost assessment with prioritized remediation roadmap. Typical duration: four to six weeks.
- **Vendor Technical Oversight** — multi-month project; buy-side technical gatekeeping for vendor-shipped AWS infrastructure on revenue-critical systems. Typical duration: three to six months.
- **Strategic Cloud Advisory** — light retainer; monthly architecture review, ad-hoc senior counsel, and decision review for engineering leaders. Typical commitment: approximately four hours per month.

Engagement scope and pricing are discussed during the initial conversation.

- Fortune 100 companies with vendor-shipped AWS infrastructure

- Companies running revenue-critical systems on AWS where downtime has measurable dollar consequences

## Who David Does Not Work With

- Junior-tier AWS implementation labor
- Engagements requiring full-time on-site presence
- Pre-revenue startups

## Frequently Asked Questions

- **What is a Fractional AWS Reliability Lead?** A senior AWS architect who works part-time inside a client organization, providing production reliability oversight, architecture review, vendor-shipped infrastructure gatekeeping, and senior escalation coverage. The senior IC role companies need but cannot justify hiring full-time.
- **What is the AWS City on a Cloud Award?** The AWS City on a Cloud Innovation Challenge is an annual Amazon Web Services award recognizing innovative cloud solutions, primarily in government and public sector work. David received the award in 2016 and 2018 during his tenure at IdeaCrew for work on state-based healthcare insurance exchanges.
- **What is David's US Patent for?** US Patent 11,146,689 covers cloud architecture, issued October 12, 2021.
- **Does David provide on-call coverage?** Yes, for ongoing retainer engagements at sufficient commitment levels.
- **Does David work with regulated industries?** Yes — career-defining work was on state-based healthcare insurance exchanges, HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2-certified.
- **How is this different from hiring an AWS Premier Partner firm?** AWS Premier Partner firms staff junior-to-mid engineers under senior account leads. A Fractional AWS Reliability Lead engagement is one named senior IC embedded directly with your team.
